name: wardrobe.ai
tagline: Camera-based try-on that shows an online clothing item on your own body to cut returns.
problem: Shoppers cannot picture clothes on their bodies, so they return a lot, which wastes resources.
solution: Computer vision finds the best frame and body keypoints; a try-on model drapes the garment over the live user, with an agent workflow.
demo_moment: Team-described: see a polo shirt mapped onto your live video.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Ribbon: Build with Ribbon (Podium)” among 131 submissions.
Frames try-on as a sustainability lever.

lessons: Tie a shopping feature to a waste number to widen its appeal.
